name: (ADFS) Metadata
description: Extracts EXIF, IPTC, XMP, PDF, audio and video metadata from uploaded files and stores it as native, Views-compatible fields (adfs_*) on the File entity. Adds a file detail page, a media source, GPS-map/thumbnail/score Views fields and Drush commands. Sub-module of Advanced Filesystem.

suggests.ext-exif: required for EXIF extraction from images.
suggests.ext-gd: used for image dimension / basic image info.

project_description: The Metadata sub-module of Advanced Filesystem reads technical and descriptive metadata from uploaded files and stores each value in a native Drupal field (prefixed adfs_) on the File entity, so it is available to Views for filtering, sorting and listing. MetadataExtractor pulls EXIF (camera, image, exposure, lens, GPS, dates, copyright), IPTC/IIM, XMP, basic image info, PDF document-information, and — where the ffprobe/ffmpeg binaries are present — audio and video metadata including embedded captions; a large MetadataDefinitions catalogue maps every attribute to a field and metadata group. Extraction fires automatically on file insert/update (via hook_file_insert/hook_file_update and a shared helper), synchronously or through the metadata_extraction queue when async mode is on, and can be re-run per file or in bulk from the UI (MetadataReextractForm, FileViewController::reextract), from Batch (MetadataBatch), or from Drush (metadata:extract, metadata:status, metadata:missing). MetadataFieldManager creates and removes the base fields for the enabled groups. A file detail page (FileViewController at /admin/content/files/{file}) shows every value grouped by category with a fill-score badge; three computed Views fields render a GPS map link (OpenStreetMap/Google Maps), an inline thumbnail and a metadata fill-score; and a MetadataSource media source exposes metadata to media types. All routes are gated behind the restricted 'administer advanced_filesystem_metadata' permission, and the re-extract action is CSRF-protected.
